oracle_cmd: FP=$(apksigner verify --min-sdk-version 28 --print-certs integ_cert16_aes128_ecb.apk | grep -m1 'certificate SHA-256' | awk '{print $NF}' | cut -c1-32); unzip -p integ_cert16_aes128_ecb.apk assets/huntress_puzzle.json | python3 -I -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"])' | base64 -d | openssl enc -d -aes-128-ecb -K $FP
